en:
## New Features

- Added a "Max" reasoning effort tier across all providers, with automatic downgrade where unsupported (Codex falls back to its highest tier; DeepSeek maps to max)
- New read-only model price popup for NUG models, showing per-token pricing, official USD reference, and effective discount
- New "min prune ratio" setting so each prune pass advances by at least a configurable amount, reducing prompt-cache invalidation and cost
- Per-model reasoning effort for NUG gateway models, with the chosen level forwarded upstream
- Unified, configurable web search system: an ordered list of search channels (native / NUG / custom API / search subagent) tried in sequence with fallback, plus a new Search settings page and a dedicated "search" subagent for delegated research
- File attribution tracking: see which narrator, subagent, or external edit last changed each file, with a "who changed this" badge in the Git panel
- Interactive browser session panel: click, scroll, drag, and type directly on live browser screenshots that auto-refresh
- Message auto-prune is now enabled by default for newly created narrators
- NUG models routed to the stateful "responses" endpoint are now recognized and labeled in the model picker

## Bug Fixes

- AskUserQuestion calls that look fine in the UI are no longer rejected by strict validation; malformed payloads are repaired consistently on the backend
- Editing and regenerating a user message now preserves attached text files instead of silently dropping them
- Forking no longer inherits the upstream conversation binding, so forks get independent NUG sticky routing instead of sharing one credential
- Corrected QR code format-information bit placement that could make some codes unreadable to certain scanners

## Improvements

- Reasoning effort tier is normalized to "auto" in the UI when a stored value is no longer offered by the current model, so the selector always shows a valid highlight
- Anthropic-compatible relays now only receive the minimal beta flags required for the effort parameter, avoiding rejected requests on generic gateways
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 全线 provider 新增「最高（Max）」推理强度档位，不支持时自动降级（Codex 回退到最高可用档，DeepSeek 映射到 max）
- NUG 模型新增只读价格弹窗，展示每 token 单价、官方美元参考价与实际优惠倍率
- 新增「最小裁剪比例」设置，每次裁剪至少推进可配置的比例，减少 prompt 缓存失效、降低计费
- NUG 网关模型支持按模型设置推理强度，并将所选档位转发上游
- 统一可配置的联网搜索系统：按顺序尝试多个搜索渠道（原生 / NUG / 自定义 API / 搜索子代理）并支持回退，新增搜索设置页和专用「search」搜索子代理
- 文件归属追踪：查看每个文件最后由哪个叙述者、子代理或外部编辑改动，Git 面板新增「谁改动了此文件」标记
- 交互式浏览器会话面板：可直接在自动刷新的浏览器截图上点击、滚动、拖拽和输入
- 新建叙述者默认开启消息自动裁剪
- 识别并标注路由到有状态「responses」端点的 NUG 模型

## 修复

- AskUserQuestion 在 UI 中正常的调用不再被严格校验拒绝，后端会一致地修复格式异常的输入
- 编辑并重新生成用户消息时保留附带的文本文件，不再静默丢失
- fork 不再继承上游会话绑定，各 fork 获得独立的 NUG sticky 路由，避免共享同一凭证
- 修正 QR 码格式信息位的放置位置，此前可能导致部分扫描器无法识别

## 优化

- 当存量推理强度档位不再被当前模型提供时，UI 归一化为「自动」显示，选择器始终展示有效高亮
- Anthropic 兼容中转仅接收 effort 参数所需的最小 beta 标志，避免通用网关因未知标志拒绝请求
